summary: Enhance your compliance skills with our Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) training course. Enroll today for expert insights!
lede: Anti-money laundering (AML) practices help institutions identify and manage financial crime risks. Designed for compliance, onboarding, operations and risk professionals, the course addresses the practical task of assessing customer and transaction risks. Learners practise applying risk-based due diligence, spotting unusual activity and documenting and escalating concerns.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly handle customer onboarding, transactions, and compliance risk.
audience: Compliance officers and AML analysts in banks
Risk managers and internal control professionals
MLROs (Money Laundering Reporting Officers) and their
Finance and grants managers in NGOs
Internal auditors and quality assurance teams
modules: Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD)
Risk-Based Approach to AML and KYC
Internal Controls, Governance, and Culture of Compliance
Technology, Data, and Automation in AML/KYC
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of financial services operations and general compliance principles. Previous experience in risk management or customer service within financial institutions is recommended but not required.
